title: Evolution of ENERGIRON Direct Reduction Plants Technology from 1957 to 2020
lineage: Process developers’ industry-conference presentation; dating for the broad HYL equipment lineage.

passages.quote: Transition from batch to continuous process.
passages.note: Tracks distinct HYL generations from the early Hylsa batch plant to continuous plants including PTKS, Indonesia, in 1980, and later units without an external reformer.
